en: Keep matter files, research sources, instructions, review notes, and editable legal work products in one persistent workspace.
Sort and rename approved matter folders locally before document comparison, chronology building, or handoff.
Choose a model for long-context review, careful drafting, or faster preparation without rebuilding the matter context.
Bring a colleague or specialist into the same work thread while keeping questions, revisions, and deliverables connected.
zh: 把案件文件、研究来源、工作要求、审阅意见和可编辑法律成果保留在一个持续工作空间中。
在本机整理并重命名核准的案件文件夹，再进入文档比较、时间线整理或团队交接。
按长上下文审阅、严谨起草或快速准备选择模型，无需重新搭建案件背景。
让同事或专业人员进入同一工作线程，使问题、修改意见和交付物始终保持关联。

en: Keep curriculum goals, readings, school templates, lesson drafts, and revisions together across a teaching unit.
Talk through a lesson idea while the agent reshapes the outline, slides, activity sheet, and teacher notes in real time.
Organize course folders, handouts, reference files, and teaching evidence locally with consistent names.
Turn lesson milestones, parent meetings, grading windows, and portfolio deadlines into prepared work blocks.
zh: 把课程目标、参考资料、学校模板、教案初稿和修改记录放在同一个单元工作空间中。
边说边调整教学想法，让 Agent 实时修改教案提纲、课件、活动单和教师备注。
在本机统一整理课程文件夹、讲义、参考资料和教学成果，并保持清晰命名。
把备课节点、家长会、批改周期和职业材料截止时间转成已经准备好的工作块。

en: Keep client context, interview notes, evidence, hypotheses, exhibits, and deliverables connected throughout an engagement.
Think through a recommendation aloud while the brief, option set, workshop plan, and deck structure change with you.
Use different models for long-document synthesis, analytical challenge, drafting, and fast iteration inside the same engagement.
Coordinate consultants and agents around one client thread, with decisions and revised deliverables returned to the group.
zh: 让客户背景、访谈记录、证据、假设、图表和交付物在整个项目周期中保持关联。
边讨论建议边修改项目简报、备选方案、工作坊计划和汇报结构。
在同一项目中分别使用适合长文档综合、分析质疑、内容起草和快速迭代的模型。
围绕同一客户线程协调顾问与 Agent，让决策和修订后的交付物回到团队。

en: Keep the research question, selected sources, coding framework, evidence matrix, and synthesis in one traceable project.
Match models to long-context reading, comparison, structured extraction, or critical review without losing the source set.
Normalize papers, reports, datasets, and notes locally so the evidence trail remains navigable.
Add reusable research procedures for source collection, evidence extraction, monitoring, or document production.
zh: 把研究问题、选定来源、编码框架、证据矩阵和综合结论保留在一个可追溯项目中。
为长上下文阅读、材料比较、结构化提取或批判性复核选择模型，同时保留同一来源集。
在本机统一论文、报告、数据集与笔记的命名，让证据路径持续可导航。
加入可复用的资料收集、证据提取、持续监测或文档生成流程。

en: Keep the approved role brief, candidate-provided material, interview rubric, notes, and communications in one hiring workspace.
Coordinate intake meetings, interview panels, follow-ups, and candidate updates as prepared calendar work.
Bring recruiters, hiring managers, interviewers, and agents into a shared thread without separating feedback from evidence.
Organize approved candidate packets and role documents locally while preserving clear separation and naming.
zh: 把核准的岗位简报、候选人材料、面试标准、记录和沟通内容放在一个招聘工作空间中。
把需求会议、面试安排、后续跟进和候选人更新组织成准备充分的日历工作。
让招聘人员、用人经理、面试官和 Agent 进入共享线程，不让反馈脱离候选人证据。
在本机整理核准的候选人资料包与岗位文件，并保持清晰的隔离和命名。

en: Keep approved financial sources, calculations, assumptions, commentary, and review notes connected across reporting cycles.
Select models for long filings, structured extraction, analytical challenge, or fast drafting while preserving the working context.
Organize statements, exports, reports, and supporting documents locally before recurring analysis and review.
Prepare recurring close, reporting, monitoring, and management-review work around real deadlines.
zh: 让核准的财务来源、计算过程、关键假设、分析说明和审阅意见跨报告周期保持关联。
针对长篇公告、结构化提取、分析质疑或快速起草选择模型，同时保留工作上下文。
在本机整理报表、数据导出、分析报告与支持文件，再进入周期分析和复核。
围绕真实截止时间准备周期结账、报告、监控和管理复盘工作。

en: Keep calendar context, prior decisions, meeting material, action registers, and executive briefs in one continuous workspace.
Connect meetings to preparation, follow-up, and protected work blocks instead of treating the calendar as a passive list.
Let leaders, assistants, teams, and agents coordinate in a shared thread while keeping decisions and deliverables visible.
Organize recurring meeting packs, leadership updates, and working documents locally with predictable naming.
zh: 把日程背景、历史决策、会议材料、行动清单和管理简报保留在一个持续工作空间中。
把会议连接到会前准备、会后跟进和受保护的工作块，而不是让日历只做被动清单。
让管理者、助理、团队与 Agent 在共享线程中协作，同时保持决策和交付物可见。
在本机整理周期会议包、管理层更新和工作文档，并保持可预测的命名。

en: Keep audience evidence, brand guidance, campaign briefs, channel drafts, approvals, and results in one campaign workspace.
Talk through positioning and creative direction while briefs, messages, and channel variants change in real time.
Choose models for research, reasoning, rapid copy variation, image work, or long-context campaign review.
Coordinate marketers, creators, reviewers, and agents around one campaign thread from brief to approved asset.
zh: 把受众证据、品牌规范、活动简报、渠道初稿、审批记录和效果数据放在同一营销工作空间中。
边讨论定位和创意方向，边实时修改活动简报、核心信息和渠道版本。
按研究、推理、快速文案变体、图像工作或长上下文活动复盘选择合适模型。
让市场人员、创作者、审阅者与 Agent 围绕同一活动线程从 Brief 协作到获批素材。
